mat_identity.brief: 返回单位仿射矩阵 / Return the identity affine matrix
mat_identity.note: 该矩阵为 {1,0,0,1,0,0}，点映射为恒等 / The matrix is `{1,0,0,1,0,0}`, mapping points unchanged

mat_mul.brief: 矩阵相乘 / Multiply two affine matrices
mat_mul.note: 结果等价于先应用 B 再应用 A / The result applies B first and then A

mat_apply.brief: 用矩阵变换一个点 / Transform a point by a matrix

mat_invert.brief: 求仿射矩阵的逆 / Invert an affine matrix
mat_invert.return: 逆矩阵；行列式接近 0 时返回单位矩阵 / The inverse, or the identity matrix when the determinant is near zero

mat_scale.brief: 求矩阵的名义均匀缩放系数 / Nominal uniform scale factor of a matrix
mat_scale.return: 缩放系数，下限钳到 1.0 / Scale factor, floored at 1.0
mat_scale.note: 用于描边宽度与字号 / Used for stroke widths and font sizes

blend_px.brief: 按覆盖率混合一个设备像素 / Blend one device pixel with a coverage value

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer

blend_px.note: 超出裁剪区、图像外或覆盖率非正的像素直接跳过 / Pixels outside the clip, outside the image, or with non-positive coverage are skipped

grad_color_at.brief: 求渐变（或纯色回退）在设备像素处的颜色 / Resolve the colour of a gradient (or a flat fallback) at a device pixel

params.grad: in:渐变描述，可为 `NULL` / Gradient description, may be `NULL`
params.ctm: in:用户空间到设备空间的矩阵 / User-to-device matrix
params.flat: in:无渐变时的纯色 / Flat colour used when there is no gradient

grad_color_at.return: 该像素处的颜色 / The colour at that pixel
grad_color_at.note: 线性渐变按沿轴的投影参数采样，径向渐变按到中心的距离采样 / A linear gradient samples the axial projection parameter; a radial one samples the distance to the centre

stroke_capsule.brief: 以胶囊形描边一条线段 / Stroke one segment as a capsule

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.x0: in:起点设备 X / Start device X
params.y0: in:起点设备 Y / Start device Y
params.x1: in:终点设备 X / End device X
params.y1: in:终点设备 Y / End device Y
params.width: in:描边宽度（设备像素）/ Stroke width in device pixels
params.c: in:纯色回退 / Flat colour fallback
params.grad: in:渐变描述，可为 `NULL` / Gradient description, may be `NULL`
params.ctm: in:用户空间到设备空间的矩阵 / User-to-device matrix

stroke_capsule.note: 每条线段各自绘制，端点为圆头；宽度非正时直接返回 / Each segment is drawn separately with round caps; returns early when the width is not positive

sub_push.brief: 向子路径追加一个顶点 / Append a vertex to a subpath
sub_push.note: 必要时按倍增扩容顶点数组 / Grows the vertex array by doubling when needed

polys_new.brief: 在多边形列表中新建一个空子路径 / Create an empty subpath in a polygon list
polys_new.return: 新分配的子路径 / The newly allocated subpath

polys_free.brief: 释放多边形列表及其全部子路径 / Free a polygon list and all its subpaths
polys_free.note: 释放后把列表重置为空 / The list is reset to empty afterwards

add_span.brief: 把一段水平覆盖按像素分箱累加 / Distribute a horizontal coverage span across pixel bins

params.cov: inout:逐像素覆盖率数组 / Per-pixel coverage array
params.x0: in:数组首列的设备 X / Device X of the array's first column
params.x1: in:数组列数 / Number of columns
params.a: in:区间起点 X / Span start X
params.b: in:区间终点 X / Span end X
params.w: in:该段的权重 / Weight of the span

add_span.note: 区间为空（b<=a）时无操作 / No-op when the span is empty (`b <= a`)

polys_bbox_clipped.brief: 求所有子路径的设备包围盒并夹紧到裁剪与限界 / Device bounding box of every subpath, clipped to the clip rect and a caller limit

params.pm: in:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.ox0: out:裁剪后左边界 / Clipped left edge
params.oy0: out:裁剪后上边界 / Clipped top edge
params.ox1: out:裁剪后右边界 / Clipped right edge
params.oy1: out:裁剪后下边界 / Clipped bottom edge

polys_scanline.brief: 收集所有边与水平线 y = sy 的交点 / Gather the x-intersections of every edge with the horizontal line `y = sy`

params.pxs: inout:交点数组，跨调用复用 / Intersection array, reused across calls
params.pnx: out:交点个数 / Number of intersections
params.pncap: inout:交点数组容量 / Intersection array capacity

sort_floats.brief: 对浮点数组做升序插入排序 / Sort a float array ascending (insertion sort)

params.xs: inout:待排序数组 / Array to sort

grad_linear_proj.brief: 求线性渐变在设备空间的原点、方向与长度平方 / Device-space origin, direction and squared length of a linear gradient

params.ctm: in:用户空间到设备空间的矩阵 / User-to-device matrix
params.lin: out:原点与方向（lin[0..1] 为原点，lin[2..3] 为方向）/ Origin and direction: `lin[0..1]` origin, `lin[2..3]` direction
params.len2: out:方向长度的平方 / Squared length of the direction

grad_radial_proj.brief: 求径向渐变在设备空间的中心与半径 / Device-space centre and radius of a radial gradient

params.ctm: in:用户空间到设备空间的矩阵 / User-to-device matrix
params.pcx: out:中心设备 X / Centre device X
params.pcy: out:中心设备 Y / Centre device Y

fill_grad_color.brief: 求设备像素中心处的填充颜色 / Resolve the fill colour at a device pixel centre

params.grad: in:渐变描述，可为 `NULL` / Gradient description, may be `NULL`
params.color: in:纯色回退 / Flat colour fallback
params.dcx: in:设备像素中心 X / Device pixel centre X
params.dcy: in:设备像素中心 Y / Device pixel centre Y
params.lin: in:线性渐变原点与方向 / Linear gradient origin and direction
params.len2: in:线性渐变方向长度平方 / Squared direction length of the linear gradient
params.rcx: in:径向渐变中心 X / Radial gradient centre X
params.rcy: in:径向渐变中心 Y / Radial gradient centre Y
params.rr: in:径向渐变半径 / Radial gradient radius

fill_grad_color.return: 该处的颜色 / The colour at that point

fill_polys.brief: 对所有子路径做奇偶规则扫描线填充 / Even-odd scanline fill of every subpath

params.color: in:纯色回退 / Flat colour fallback
params.grad: in:渐变描述，可为 `NULL` / Gradient description, may be `NULL`
params.ctm: in:用户空间到设备空间的矩阵 / User-to-device matrix

fill_polys.note: 每行取四个子扫描线并按 0.25 权重累加覆盖率；支持纯色与渐变 / Each row uses four sub-scanlines accumulated with 0.25 weight; supports solid colour and gradients

stroke_polys.brief: 沿所有子路径逐段描边 / Stroke every subpath segment by segment

params.color: in:纯色回退 / Flat colour fallback
params.grad: in:渐变描述，可为 `NULL` / Gradient description, may be `NULL`

stroke_polys.note: 闭合子路径额外补画首尾相连的一段以保持视觉连续 / A closed subpath also draws the wrap-around segment for visual continuity

attr.brief: 读取非空属性值 / Read a non-empty attribute value
attr.return: 属性值；缺失或为空时返回 `NULL` / The value, or `NULL` when absent or empty

attr_num.brief: 把数值属性读入浮点数 / Parse a numeric attribute into a float
attr_num.return: 解析成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 on success, else 0

attr_color.brief: 解析颜色属性 / Parse a colour attribute

params.name: in:属性名 / Attribute name
params.out: out:解析出的颜色 / Parsed colour

attr_color.return: 属性存在返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the attribute exists, else 0
attr_color.note: `none` 得到全透明色；无法解析时回退为不透明黑 / `none` yields a fully transparent colour; an unparsable value falls back to opaque black

ctx_apply_style.brief: 把元素上的绘制属性应用到上下文 / Apply a node's paint attributes to the context
ctx_apply_style.note: 读取 fill、stroke、stroke-width、fill-opacity、stroke-opacity / Reads fill, stroke, stroke-width, fill-opacity and stroke-opacity

transform_rotate.brief: 构造绕点旋转（rotate 三参数形式）的矩阵 / Build the matrix for a rotation about a point (3-argument `rotate`)

params.ang_deg: in:旋转角度（度）/ Rotation angle in degrees

transform_rotate.return: 旋转矩阵 / The rotation matrix
transform_rotate.note: 参数至少 3 个时以 v[1],v[2] 为旋转中心 / When at least three arguments are given, `v[1]` and `v[2]` are the rotation centre

transform_from_name.brief: 把变换名与参数映射为矩阵 / Map a transform name and its arguments to a matrix
transform_from_name.return: 对应的矩阵 / The corresponding matrix
transform_from_name.note: 支持 translate/scale/rotate/skewX/skewY/matrix；名称未知或参数不足时返回单位矩阵 / Supports translate, scale, rotate, skewX, skewY and matrix; returns the identity when the name is unknown or the argument count is short

transform_read_name.brief: 读取变换名并前移游标 / Read a transform name and advance the cursor

params.pp: inout:解析游标指针 / Parse cursor pointer
params.name: out:接收变换名 / Receives the transform name
params.cap: in:`name` 缓冲区容量 / Capacity of the `name` buffer

transform_read_args.brief: 读取括号内最多 cap 个数值参数 / Read up to `cap` numeric arguments inside the parentheses

params.pp: inout:解析游标指针 / Parse cursor pointer
params.v: out:接收参数值 / Receives the argument values
params.cap: in:参数数组容量 / Capacity of the argument array

transform_read_args.return: 实际解析到的参数个数 / Number of arguments actually parsed
transform_read_args.note: 会跳过逗号与空白，并至少前进到右括号之后 / Skips commas and whitespace and always advances past the closing parenthesis

transform_skip_parens.brief: 跳过一段括号参数（避免死循环）/ Skip a parenthesised argument list to avoid an endless loop
transform_skip_parens.return: 右括号之后的指针 / Pointer past the closing parenthesis

parse_transform.brief: 解析 transform 属性为累积矩阵 / Parse a `transform` attribute into an accumulated matrix

params.s: in:transform 属性文本 / The `transform` attribute text

parse_transform.return: 累积后的变换矩阵 / The accumulated transform matrix
parse_transform.note: 多个变换按出现顺序左乘累加；`s` 为 `NULL` 时返回单位矩阵 / Multiple transforms accumulate left to right; returns the identity when `s` is `NULL`

find_by_id.brief: 在子树中按 id 查找元素 / Find an element by id within a subtree
find_by_id.return: 匹配的元素；未找到时返回 `NULL` / The matching element, or `NULL` when not found

parse_offset.brief: 解析渐变色标偏移 / Parse a gradient stop offset
parse_offset.return: 归一化偏移；带 `%` 时除以 100 / The normalised offset, divided by 100 when it carries a `%`

parse_gradient_geometry.brief: 读取线性/径向渐变的几何属性 / Read the geometry attributes of a linear or radial gradient

params.g: out:渐变描述，被写入 / Gradient description, written to

parse_gradient_geometry.note: 线性读 x1/y1/x2/y2，径向读 cx/cy/r / Linear reads x1/y1/x2/y2; radial reads cx/cy/r

parse_gradient_stop.brief: 把一个 `<stop>` 子元素追加到色标列表 / Append one `<stop>` child to the gradient's stop list
parse_gradient_stop.note: 读取 offset、stop-color、stop-opacity / Reads offset, stop-color and stop-opacity

parse_gradient.brief: 从 `<linearGradient>`/`<radialGradient>` 元素填充渐变描述 / Fill a gradient description from a `<linearGradient>`/`<radialGradient>` element
parse_gradient.return: 有色标返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the gradient has stops, else 0
parse_gradient.note: 标签不匹配时返回 0；色标最多收集 SVG_MAX_STOPS 个 / Returns 0 when the tag does not match; collects at most SVG_MAX_STOPS stops

resolve_gradient.brief: 把 `fill`/`stroke` 的 `url(#id)` 解析为渐变 / Resolve a `fill`/`stroke` `url(#id)` into a gradient

params.which: in:属性名（fill 或 stroke）/ Attribute name, `fill` or `stroke`
params.out: out:解析出的渐变 / Resolved gradient
params.ux0: in:形状用户空间包围盒左 / Shape user-space bbox left
params.uy0: in:形状用户空间包围盒上 / Shape user-space bbox top
params.ux1: in:形状用户空间包围盒右 / Shape user-space bbox right
params.uy1: in:形状用户空间包围盒下 / Shape user-space bbox bottom

resolve_gradient.return: 解析成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 on success, else 0
resolve_gradient.note: objectBoundingBox 单位下把分数坐标映射到形状的用户包围盒 / For objectBoundingBox units the fractional coordinates are mapped onto the shape's user bbox

dev_move.brief: 开启新子路径并落到设备空间起点 / Open a new subpath at a device-space point

params.ux: in:用户空间 X / User-space X
params.uy: in:用户空间 Y / User-space Y

dev_move.note: 用户坐标经 CTM 变换后再入队 / User coordinates are mapped by the CTM before being stored

dev_line.brief: 在当前子路径追加一条线段 / Append a line segment to the current subpath

params.ux: in:用户空间 X / User-space X
params.uy: in:用户空间 Y / User-space Y

dev_line.note: 尚无子路径时退化为 dev_move / Degrades to dev_move when no subpath exists yet

flatten_cubic.brief: 把三次贝塞尔曲线展平为线段 / Flatten a cubic Bezier curve into line segments

params.x1: in:第一控制点 X / First control point X
params.y1: in:第一控制点 Y / First control point Y
params.x2: in:第二控制点 X / Second control point X
params.y2: in:第二控制点 Y / Second control point Y

flatten_cubic.note: 按控制多边形长度与缩放估算步数，上限 200 / The step count is estimated from the control polygon length and the scale, capped at 200

flatten_quad.brief: 把二次贝塞尔曲线展平为线段 / Flatten a quadratic Bezier curve into line segments

params.x1: in:控制点 X / Control point X
params.y1: in:控制点 Y / Control point Y

flatten_quad.note: 按控制多边形长度与缩放估算步数，上限 200 / The step count is estimated from the control polygon length and the scale, capped at 200

arc_center_params.brief: 把椭圆弧的端点式参数化为中心式 / Endpoint-to-centre parameterisation of an SVG elliptical arc

params.rx: inout:X 半径，过大时被放大 / X radius, scaled up when too small
params.ry: inout:Y 半径，过大时被放大 / Y radius, scaled up when too small
params.phi: in:X 轴旋转角（度）/ X-axis rotation in degrees
params.sweep: in:扫描方向标志 / Sweep flag
params.trig: out:旋转角的 cos/sin / Cosine and sine of the rotation angle
params.out_theta1: out:起始角（弧度）/ Start angle in radians
params.out_dtheta: out:扫过角（弧度）/ Swept angle in radians

arc_center_params.note: 按 SVG 规范 F.6.5 实现 / Follows the SVG spec's implementation notes F.6.5

flatten_arc.brief: 把椭圆弧展平为线段 / Flatten an elliptical arc into line segments

params.phi: in:X 轴旋转角（度）/ X-axis rotation in degrees
params.sweep: in:扫描方向标志 / Sweep flag

flatten_arc.note: 半径之一为 0 时退化为直线；步数按扫过角与半径估算，上限 200 / Degrades to a straight line when either radius is zero; the step count is estimated from the sweep and radius, capped at 200

path_cmd_argc.brief: 查路径命令所需的参数个数 / Look up the argument count a path command needs

params.upper: in:大写命令字母 / Uppercased command letter

path_cmd_argc.return: 参数个数；未知命令返回 -1 / The argument count, or -1 for an unknown command

path_isspace.brief: 判断字符是否为路径分隔空白 / Test whether a character is a path separator
path_isspace.return: 是空格/逗号/制表/换行返回 1 / 1 for space, comma, tab or newline

path_skip_sep.brief: 跳过当前位置的分隔符 / Skip separators at the current position

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state

path_read_args.brief: 读取最多 want 个数字参数 / Read up to `want` numeric arguments

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.a: out:接收参数值 / Receives the argument values
params.want: in:期望的参数个数 / Desired argument count

path_read_args.return: 实际解析到的个数 / Number actually parsed

path_cmd_z.brief: 闭合当前子路径 / Close the current subpath

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state

path_cmd_z.note: 标记子路径闭合并把当前点移回子路径起点 / Marks the subpath closed and moves the current point back to the subpath start

path_cmd_move.brief: 执行 M 移动命令 / Execute an `M` move command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_cmd_move.note: 按规范，紧随的坐标对被视为隐式 lineto / Per the spec, following coordinate pairs are treated as implicit line-tos

path_cmd_line.brief: 执行 L 直线命令 / Execute an `L` line command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_cmd_line.note: 尚无子路径时以该点为起点 / Uses the point as the new subpath start when none exists

path_cmd_h.brief: 执行 H 水平线命令 / Execute an `H` horizontal line command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_cmd_v.brief: 执行 V 垂直线命令 / Execute a `V` vertical line command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_cmd_cubic.brief: 执行 C 三次贝塞尔命令 / Execute a `C` cubic curve command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_cmd_cubic.note: 记录第二控制点供后续 S 反射使用 / Records the second control point for a following `S` reflection

path_cmd_smooth_cubic.brief: 执行 S 平滑三次贝塞尔命令 / Execute an `S` smooth cubic curve command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_cmd_smooth_cubic.note: 首个控制点由前一控制点关于当前点反射得到 / The first control point is the previous control point reflected about the current point

path_cmd_quad.brief: 执行 Q 二次贝塞尔命令 / Execute a `Q` quadratic curve command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_cmd_quad.note: 记录控制点供后续 T 反射使用 / Records the control point for a following `T` reflection

path_cmd_smooth_quad.brief: 执行 T 平滑二次贝塞尔命令 / Execute a `T` smooth quadratic curve command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_cmd_smooth_quad.note: 控制点由前一控制点关于当前点反射得到 / The control point is the previous control point reflected about the current point

path_cmd_arc.brief: 执行 A 椭圆弧命令 / Execute an `A` elliptical arc command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_skip_unknown.brief: 跳过一个无法识别的命令 / Skip one unrecognised command

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state

path_skip_unknown.note: 若当前位置不含数字则只前进一个字符 / Advances just one character when the current position holds no number

path_apply.brief: 把一个命令的参数分派给对应处理器 / Dispatch one command's arguments to its handler

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state
params.upper: in:大写命令字母 / Uppercased command letter
params.rel: in:相对命令为 1 / 1 for a relative command

path_apply.note: 默认分支按 A（椭圆弧）处理 / The default branch handles `A` (elliptical arc)

path_run_command.brief: 消费当前命令的参数并执行 / Consume the current command's argument list and apply it

params.pb: inout:路径构建状态 / Path build state

path_run_command.note: 参数不足时清空游标以停止扫描；Z 直接闭合 / Clears the cursor to stop the scan when arguments run short; `Z` closes directly

build_path.brief: 解析路径 `d` 数据构建设备空间多边形 / Parse path `d` data into device-space polygons

params.p: out:接收几何的多边形列表 / Polygon list receiving the geometry

build_path.note: `d` 为 `NULL` 时无操作；命令字母切换当前命令，其余交给 path_run_command / No-op when `d` is `NULL`; command letters switch the current command and the rest goes to path_run_command

collect_text.brief: 收集元素子树内的文本 / Collect the text inside an element's subtree

params.buf: out:接收文本的缓冲区 / Buffer receiving the text
params.len: inout:已写入长度，被累加 / Length written so far, accumulated

collect_text.note: 跳过 title/desc 子元素；缓冲区满时不再追加 / Skips `title`/`desc` children; stops appending when the buffer is full

draw_text_read_attrs.brief: 读取 `<text>` 的文本与锚点属性 / Read a `<text>` element's text and anchor attributes

params.dt: out:文本绘制参数 / Text draw parameters

draw_text_read_attrs.return: 有文本返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when there is text, else 0
draw_text_read_attrs.note: 解析 x/y/font-size/textLength/font-weight/fill 与 text-anchor、dominant-baseline / Parses x/y/font-size/textLength/font-weight/fill plus text-anchor and dominant-baseline

draw_text_stretched.brief: 按 textLength 拉伸 advanc 逐字绘制文本 / Draw text glyph by glyph with advances stretched to match `textLength`

params.len: in:文本字节长度 / Text byte length
params.dev_x: in:设备起点 X / Device start X
params.dev_y: in:设备基线 Y / Device baseline Y
params.scale: in:CTM 缩放系数 / CTM scale factor

draw_text.brief: 绘制一个 `<text>` 元素 / Draw a `<text>` element
draw_text.note: 锚点与基线关键字修正绘制起点；给出 textLength 且多字符时走拉伸绘制 / Anchor and baseline keywords adjust the origin; a `textLength` with more than one character goes through the stretched path

ellipse_path.brief: 构建椭圆/圆的多边形路径（用户空间）/ Build an ellipse/circle polygon path in user space
ellipse_path.note: 用 64 段采样逼近，路径闭合 / Approximated with 64 samples and closed

round_rect_path.brief: 构建圆角矩形多边形路径 / Build a rounded-rectangle polygon path
round_rect_path.note: 半径夹紧到半宽/半高；每个圆角用 8 段采样，路径闭合 / The radius is clamped to half the width and height; each corner is sampled with 8 segments and the path is closed

points_path.brief: 从 points 属性构建多边形/折线 / Build a polygon/polyline from a `points` attribute

params.closed: in:闭合为 1 / 1 for a closed path

points_path.note: `pts` 为 `NULL` 时无操作；顶点成对解析 / No-op when `pts` is `NULL`; points are parsed in pairs

points_bbox.brief: 求 points 串的用户空间包围盒 / User-space bbox of a `points` list

path_bbox.brief: 求路径串的用户空间包围盒 / User-space bbox of a path string
path_bbox.note: 用单位矩阵求值，用于把 objectBoundingBox 渐变映射到路径上 / Evaluated with an identity matrix so objectBoundingBox gradients can map onto paths

grad_scale_alpha.brief: 按给定系数缩放所有色标的 alpha / Scale every gradient stop's alpha by a factor

paint_shape_fill.brief: 用纯色或渐变填充一个形状 / Fill a shape with a solid colour or a gradient

params.fill: in:纯色回退 / Flat colour fallback
params.fop: in:填充不透明度 / Fill opacity
params.ux0: in:用户空间包围盒左 / User-space bbox left
params.uy0: in:用户空间包围盒上 / User-space bbox top
params.ux1: in:用户空间包围盒右 / User-space bbox right
params.uy1: in:用户空间包围盒下 / User-space bbox bottom

paint_shape_fill.note: 渐变解析成功时优先使用并缩放其 alpha / When the gradient resolves it is used and its alpha is scaled

paint_shape_stroke.brief: 用纯色或渐变描边一个形状 / Stroke a shape with a solid colour or a gradient

params.stroke: in:纯色回退 / Flat colour fallback
params.sop: in:描边不透明度 / Stroke opacity
params.ux0: in:用户空间包围盒左 / User-space bbox left
params.uy0: in:用户空间包围盒上 / User-space bbox top
params.ux1: in:用户空间包围盒右 / User-space bbox right
params.uy1: in:用户空间包围盒下 / User-space bbox bottom

paint_shape_stroke.note: 描边宽度按 CTM 缩放 / The stroke width is scaled by the CTM

paint_shape.brief: 填充并/或描边一个已构建的形状 / Fill and/or stroke an already-built shape

params.ux0: in:用户空间包围盒左 / User-space bbox left
params.uy0: in:用户空间包围盒上 / User-space bbox top
params.ux1: in:用户空间包围盒右 / User-space bbox right
params.uy1: in:用户空间包围盒下 / User-space bbox bottom

paint_shape.note: 元素自身的 fill/stroke/opacity 属性覆盖继承状态 / The element's own fill/stroke/opacity attributes override the inherited state

draw_children.brief: 绘制父元素的所有元素子节点 / Draw all element children of a parent

params.ctm: in:当前变换矩阵 / Current transformation matrix

draw_children.note: 非元素子节点被跳过 / Non-element children are skipped

svg_is_metadata_tag.brief: 判断标签是否只承载元数据、不直接绘制 / Test whether a tag carries metadata only and is never painted directly
svg_is_metadata_tag.return: 是元数据标签返回 1，否则 0 / 1 for a metadata tag, else 0

draw_use_ref.brief: 绘制 `<use>` 引用的元素 / Draw the element referenced by a `<use>`

params.sub: out:派生子上下文 / Derived sub-context
params.ctm: in:当前变换矩阵 / Current transformation matrix

draw_use_ref.note: 按 x/y 平移并应用 use 的样式，随后递归绘制引用元素 / Translated by x/y, applies the `use` style, then recursively draws the referenced element

draw_container.brief: 绘制 `<g>`/`<svg>` 容器 / Draw a `<g>`/`<svg>` container

params.sub: out:派生子上下文 / Derived sub-context
params.ctm: in:当前变换矩阵 / Current transformation matrix

draw_container.note: 压入样式后递归；`<svg>` 额外按其 x/y 偏移 / Pushes the style and recurses; `<svg>` is additionally offset by its x/y

draw_rect_node.brief: 绘制 `<rect>` 元素 / Draw a `<rect>` element

params.sub: inout:SVG 子上下文 / SVG sub-context

draw_rect_node.note: rx 缺失时回退到 ry；宽或高非正时不绘制 / Falls back to `ry` when `rx` is absent; draws nothing when the width or height is not positive

draw_ellipse_node.brief: 绘制 `<circle>`/`<ellipse>` 元素 / Draw a `<circle>`/`<ellipse>` element

params.sub: inout:SVG 子上下文 / SVG sub-context

draw_ellipse_node.note: 圆形取 r 作为两半径；半径非正时不绘制 / A circle uses `r` for both radii; draws nothing when a radius is not positive

draw_line_node.brief: 绘制 `<line>` 元素 / Draw a `<line>` element

params.sub: inout:SVG 子上下文 / SVG sub-context

draw_line_node.note: 只描边不填充 / Stroked only, never filled

draw_poly_node.brief: 绘制 `<polygon>`/`<polyline>` 元素 / Draw a `<polygon>`/`<polyline>` element

params.sub: inout:SVG 子上下文 / SVG sub-context

draw_poly_node.note: polygon 填充并描边，polyline 只描边 / `polygon` is filled and stroked while `polyline` is stroked only

draw_path_node.brief: 绘制 `<path>` 元素 / Draw a `<path>` element

params.sub: inout:SVG 子上下文 / SVG sub-context

draw_path_node.note: 以单位矩阵求包围盒供渐变映射 / The bbox for gradient mapping is computed with an identity matrix

draw_shape.brief: 在独立样式的子上下文中绘制一个叶子形状 / Draw a leaf shape in its own styled sub-context

params.ctm: in:当前变换矩阵 / Current transformation matrix

draw_shape.note: 按标签分派到 text/rect/circle/ellipse/line/polygon/polyline/path；未知元素递归子节点以免内容丢失 / Dispatches on the tag to text/rect/circle/ellipse/line/polygon/polyline/path; an unknown element recurses into its children so nested content is not lost

draw_element.brief: 绘制一个 SVG 元素 / Draw one SVG element

params.ctm: in:当前变换矩阵 / Current transformation matrix

draw_element.note: 元数据标签跳过；先累积元素的 transform，再按标签分派到容器/use/形状 / Metadata tags are skipped; the element transform is accumulated first, then dispatch goes to container, `use` or shape

svg_ctx_init.brief: 从 `<svg>` 盒初始化 SVG 绘制上下文 / Seed the SVG drawing context from the `<svg>` box

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.node: in:`<svg>` DOM 节点 / The `<svg>` DOM node
params.y_dev: in:盒子顶边的设备 y / Device y of the box top edge

svg_ctx_init.note: 设置设备空间 CTM 原点、视口尺寸与默认绘制状态 / Sets the device-space CTM origin, viewport size and default paint state

svg_apply_viewbox.brief: 应用 viewBox 变换 / Apply the viewBox transform

params.node: in:`<svg>` DOM 节点 / The `<svg>` DOM node
params.vw: out:viewBox 宽度（存在时）/ viewBox width when present
params.vh: out:viewBox 高度（存在时）/ viewBox height when present

svg_apply_viewbox.note: 取均匀缩放并居中；无 viewBox 或格式非法时不变换 / Uses a uniform scale plus centring; does nothing when there is no viewBox or it is malformed

hpe_svg_paint.brief: 绘制 `<svg>` 子树 / Paint the `<svg>` subtree

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.y_dev: in:盒子顶边的设备 y / Device y of the box top edge

hpe_svg_paint.note: 裁剪到 SVG 视口并与已激活的损伤矩形求交，避免半透明描边在滚动中被重复混合而变暗 / Clips to the SVG viewport and intersects the already-active damage rect so translucent strokes are not blended twice and darkened on scroll

attr_f.brief: 读取数值属性，缺失时返回默认值 / Read a numeric attribute, returning a default when absent
attr_f.return: 属性值或默认值 / The attribute value, or the default

point_in_polys.brief: 用奇偶规则判断点是否在多边形内 / Test whether a point is inside the polygons using the even-odd rule
point_in_polys.return: 在内部返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when inside, else 0

use_ref_id.brief: 从 `<use>` 的 href/xlink:href 取片段 id / Extract the fragment id from a `<use>` `href`/`xlink:href`

params.id: out:接收片段 id / Receives the fragment id
params.cap: in:`id` 缓冲区容量 / Capacity of the `id` buffer

use_ref_id.return: 解析成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 on success, else 0

hit_children.brief: 命中测试所有元素子节点 / Hit test all element children

params.dx: in:设备点 X / Device point X
params.dy: in:设备点 Y / Device point Y

hit_children.return: 最深命中子节点，未命中返回 `NULL` / The deepest hit child, or `NULL` when nothing is hit
hit_children.note: 后出现的兄弟覆盖先出现的，因此取最后一个命中 / Later siblings paint on top, so the last hit wins

hit_rect.brief: 命中测试一个 `<rect>` / Hit test a `<rect>`

params.ux: in:用户空间 X / User-space X
params.uy: in:用户空间 Y / User-space Y

hit_rect.return: 命中则返回该元素，否则 `NULL` / The element when hit, else `NULL`

hit_ellipse.brief: 命中测试一个 `<circle>`/`<ellipse>` / Hit test a `<circle>`/`<ellipse>`

params.ux: in:用户空间 X / User-space X
params.uy: in:用户空间 Y / User-space Y

hit_ellipse.return: 命中则返回该元素，否则 `NULL` / The element when hit, else `NULL`
hit_ellipse.note: 把点归一化到单位圆判断 / The point is normalised against the unit circle

hit_line.brief: 命中测试一条 `<line>` / Hit test a `<line>`

params.ux: in:用户空间 X / User-space X
params.uy: in:用户空间 Y / User-space Y

hit_line.return: 命中则返回该元素，否则 `NULL` / The element when hit, else `NULL`
hit_line.note: 线段周围约 3px 容差 / About 3 px tolerance around the segment

hit_points.brief: 命中测试 `<polygon>`/`<polyline>` / Hit test a `<polygon>`/`<polyline>`

params.ux: in:用户空间 X / User-space X
params.uy: in:用户空间 Y / User-space Y

hit_points.return: 命中则返回该元素，否则 `NULL` / The element when hit, else `NULL`
hit_points.note: 在单位矩阵空间构建几何后测点 / The geometry is built in identity space before the point test

hit_path.brief: 命中测试一个 `<path>` / Hit test a `<path>`

params.ux: in:用户空间 X / User-space X
params.uy: in:用户空间 Y / User-space Y

hit_path.return: 命中则返回该元素，否则 `NULL` / The element when hit, else `NULL`
hit_path.note: 在单位矩阵空间构建几何后测点 / The geometry is built in identity space before the point test

hit_text.brief: 命中测试一个 `<text>` / Hit test a `<text>`

params.ux: in:用户空间 X / User-space X
params.uy: in:用户空间 Y / User-space Y

hit_text.return: 命中则返回该元素，否则 `NULL` / The element when hit, else `NULL`
hit_text.note: 以锚点与字号估算文本框 / The text box is estimated from the anchor point and the font size

hit_shape.brief: 命中测试一个叶子形状 / Hit test a leaf shape

params.dx: in:设备点 X / Device point X
params.dy: in:设备点 Y / Device point Y

hit_shape.return: 命中则返回该元素，否则 `NULL` / The element when hit, else `NULL`
hit_shape.note: 先把设备点经逆矩阵映射到用户空间 / The device point is inverse-mapped into user space first

hit_use.brief: 命中测试一个 `<use>` / Hit test a `<use>`

params.dx: in:设备点 X / Device point X
params.dy: in:设备点 Y / Device point Y

hit_use.return: 最深命中节点，未命中返回 `NULL` / The deepest hit node, or `NULL`
hit_use.note: 把 use 的 transform 与 x/y 压入 CTM 后递归引用元素 / Pushes the `use` transform and x/y onto the CTM, then recurses into the referenced element

hit_walk.brief: 递归遍历 SVG 树做命中测试 / Walk the SVG tree recursively for hit testing

params.dx: in:设备点 X / Device point X
params.dy: in:设备点 Y / Device point Y

hit_walk.return: 最深命中节点，未命中返回 `NULL` / The deepest hit node, or `NULL`
hit_walk.note: defs/title/desc 不参与命中；g/svg 压入 transform 后递归子节点，use 与形状各自处理 / `defs`/`title`/`desc` never hit; `g`/`svg` push their transform and recurse while `use` and shapes are handled separately

hpe_svg_hit_test.brief: 对 `<svg>` 子树做命中测试 / Hit test an `<svg>` subtree

params.x: in:文档坐标 X / Document-space X
params.y: in:文档坐标 Y / Document-space Y

hpe_svg_hit_test.return: 最深的包含该点的 SVG 元素，未命中返回 `NULL` / The deepest SVG element containing the point, or `NULL`
hpe_svg_hit_test.note: 以盒内容盒左上角为原点，并按 viewBox 缩放居中；路径目前尚未参与命中测试 / The origin is the box's content-box top-left with viewBox scaling and centring applied; paths are not hit tested yet
